name: Sengoku Hime 5 ~Senka Tatsu Haou no Keifu~
original_name: 戦極姫５ ～戦禍断つ覇王の系譜～
source:
This is the sequel to Sengokuhime 4, offering an alternate ‘if’ retelling of the Sengoku era. The main routes are for the Oda family after the Battle of Okehazama, as well as a new one for the Chousokabe family. There’s additions to the routes for the other lords, which number over 120. The system has been updated with a seamless world map, potential rebellion outbreaks, military type branching, improved naval fights, among others. 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/12/01/december-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《战极姬4》的续作，以另一种“假如”的方式重述战国时代。主要路线包括桶狭间之战后的织田家，以及新增的长宗我部家路线。其他大名的路线也增添了内容，登场领主超过120位。系统进行了多项更新，包括无缝世界地图、可能爆发的叛乱、兵种分支，以及改进的海战等。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/12/01/december-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
